_doc: Per-execution-block ALMA project codes for the blocks whose harvested obscore metadata carries no member OUS, so neither the direct route nor the member-OUS route in projcodes_v400.py can resolve them. Resolved by querying the ALMA Science Archive TAP service for the block's own ASDM UID, which answers for both of them; the earlier note that the service 'would not answer for them' was wrong. Both are ordinary science blocks of accepted proposals, which is what referee 2's minor point 9 asks us to establish.
_source: https://almascience.eso.org/tap/sync  (ivoa.obscore, SELECT DISTINCT proposal_id, member_ous_uid, obs_title WHERE asdm_uid LIKE '%<block>%'), cross-checked against the NRAO and NAOJ mirrors
